reason: The application publishes no capability that deletes a customer. Its customer capabilities are customers.list@1, customers.lookup@1 and billing.contact@1, which only observe, and customers.register@1, which is consequential but only creates customers. Deleting a record would need a new capability with its own contract: its inputs, its consequential effect, an authorization such as customers.write or a dedicated delete permission, declared failures such as 'not found', and verification. It would also need a decision on what happens to dependants like billing.contact@1 when a customer is removed. I cannot meet the goal by changing one capability's implementation. Changing an existing capability to delete records would break its contract. A delete capability (for example customers.delete@1) must first be defined and added to the application's contracts. Once it exists, its implementation can be written and verified.
